needed.evidence: People are walking in the road and there is no designated sidewalk area.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated sidewalk on the left side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The sidewalk surface is uneven with debris and broken sections.
needed.suggestion: Repair the broken pavement and clear debris from the right-side sidewalk to improve safety.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are crossing the road without any designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the street.

needed.evidence: The lack of any crossing facility makes crossing dangerous and unpredictable.
needed.suggestion: Implement a signalised or marked crossing to regulate pedestrian and vehicle flow.

needed.evidence: There are no dropped kerbs to facilitate accessibility at crossing points.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at designated crossing points to improve accessibility for all users.

needed.evidence: No street lighting poles are visible along this urban commercial stretch.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety during night-time.
